title: Meta root package.json
description: Required scripts and commitlint tooling for the meta-repo root package.json. Checks use the test:* namespace; build and pulumi:* are separate. lint/check-types/build/test are meta-local (CI + lefthook parity with projects). use test:eslint (tool-named; never test:lint). Meta-local gates use test:<gate>; sibling fan-out uses nx:projects:*; meta+siblings use nx:test:<gate>. Global umbrella: nx:test. Project/shared sibling package.json files use @sargonpiraev/eslint-config schemas (SSOT under shared/packages/eslint-config/src/schemas).
